instruction: Redis SET with NX (only if key does not exist)
Redis GETSET atomically get and set
Redis EXPIRE set timeout on existing key
Redis PEXPIRE set timeout in milliseconds
Redis EXISTS check if key exists
Redis RENAME a key
Redis EXPIREAT set expiry as Unix timestamp
Redis TTL check remaining time to live
Redis PTTL check remaining TTL in milliseconds
Redis PERSIST remove expiry from key
Redis SETEX set with expiry in one command
Redis INCRBYFLOAT for floating point increment
Redis DECR decrement counter
Redis DECRBY decrement by specific amount
Redis STRLEN get string length
Redis APPEND to string value
Redis GETRANGE substring from string
Redis SETRANGE overwrite part of string
Redis MSETNX set multiple keys only if none exist
output: redis-cli MSETNX key1 val1 key2 val2

instruction: Redis RPUSH push to end of list
Redis LPOP pop from start of list
Redis RPOP pop from end of list
Redis LINDEX get element at index in list
Redis LSET set element at index in list
Redis LREM remove elements from list
Redis LINSERT insert before/after pivot in list
